correctness.rationale: A selected nonleaf (t,h) obstructs the unique length-two path between two distinct T-neighbor layers, so feasible sets live only in leaves. For endpoints in a leaf, the H-layer is convex and forces its S_v total mutual-visible; for endpoints in different tree layers a nonleaf point w of the unique T path supplies an entirely unselected H traversal, proving independent sufficiency. R_n factor has exactly two full row-simplex families and n vertical edges; thus local F=2(1+z)^n-1+n z^2 and M=2z^n+n z^2. Collapsing both row simplices onto stars produces graph cycle rank n-1, and joining ell copies gives wedge of (n-1)^ell spheres S^{2ell-1}. n=2 gives C4 local factor; T order>=3 avoids adjacent leaves. Independent BFS on all 4096 subsets of P3 square K2 square K2 confirmed all-face polynomial [1,8,24,32,16], including forbidden internal layers.
